research_questions: Q1 (the construction, exact statement). For a ladder path g and positions u < v inside one pending region with objAt g u = objAt g v and tpOf (for the stab-free closure of phi, box letters included) equal at u and v along g's own history, is the path with the block (u, v] DUPLICATED -- and, separately, DELETED -- type-preserving at every position outside the block when read through the landed retraction spliceIdx / embedding spliceEmb (LadderAgree.lean)? The planner's own sketch closes both seam cases of the U and S clauses by applying the endpoint type equality to the formula psi U chi ITSELF (a hypothesis of the lemma, since psi U chi is in the closure -- never the induction hypothesis) after transporting psi and chi at the other positions by the IH. Confirm this against the landed PlusTruth.untl_iff / PlusTruth.snce_iff conventions (strict vs reflexive witness, where psi is required), and against Hodkinson-Wolter-Zakharyaschev 2000 Lemma 17 (the splice lemma over <Z,<>, literature briefing entry 83) and the composition method (Thomas 1997; Libkin ch. 3 and 7). Record the exact Lean statement shape -- hypotheses on u, v, the pend profile and the lift's pin side condition -- that a plan can pin as a Lean Challenge Statement.

Q2 (exact-target divisibility, the obstruction a correct pump still faces). A type-respecting block of length l (pigeonhole budget l <= card Q * 2^|closure| <= Tc, settled by specs/761_ladder_realization_theorem/prototype/step0-budget-check.lean) moves cntAt at z only by multiples of l, but kappa_eq_components puts a saturated-regime collision at c' = c + m*(P+1), and the only certificate-free divisor of P+1 is objCycleLens (l <= card Q; issue iss_1792402772629_BNdiN5 in task 761's issues.jsonl). Determine which certificate-free route reaches the EXACT target: (a) a pigeonhole on (objAt, tpOf, position mod (P+1)) yielding a block of length d*(P+1) with 1 <= d <= budget, followed by a chain/generator argument over the class (common shift by P+1; clipped-gap regime via clipIdx_regime_of_eq) -- does it still need d = 1?; (b) a certificate-free eventual periodicity of the realized (objAt, tpOf) sequence inside a long pending region with period dividing P+1 (the model-level pumping lemma LadderAgree.lean's docstring names as not landed); (c) another device. If none is certificate-free, state precisely which boundary fact would be needed (e.g. that a realized stab-free pair-cycle is a prodCycleLens member via cohIdle/SatCl, CounterQuotient.lean) and whether consuming it at depth 0 is actually circular, given that the recorded circularity runs through certStabK / stab_mem_tpOf_iff_cell, which a stab-free closure never reaches. This is a route-decision INPUT for the plan and the user, not a decision to take inside research.

Q3 (the pin cascade under type preservation). Inserting a block between z and the region's end raises the region-start pin by l (cntAt_eq_nxtAt_of_idle_pend, pinCompat_of_ladderPath), so outside the pending-forever-into-the-past regime (exists_spliced_ladderPath_of_pend_past) the next-deadline register must ramp by l across the preceding idle run and previous region under Drift (1-Lipschitz, RunLayer.lean). The recorded cascade lengthens idle runs type-blindly. Determine whether the ramp can always be absorbed type-respectingly: can an idle run or a previous pending region SHORTER than the pigeonhole budget be lengthened at all; does a pure re-profile of n over an UNCHANGED walk change any atom row (lab never reads n, so this is half (i), tpOf_eq_of_objAt_eq_of_pinned -- check whether the ramp fits the Lipschitz window without touching the walk); and is Phase 11.8's cascade in task 761 plan 08 a prerequisite of this construction or independent of it?

Q4 (the n coordinate in general). nxt_free closes the n half only on Probe761C's own object (no region start anywhere in the past). For each collision regime of kappa (n = n'; both >= Tn with equal residue; gap clipped vs unclipped, so c and n shift jointly or independently by multiples of P+1), identify the surgery that moves nxtAt at z by the required amount while holding c: a re-profile of n alone over the unchanged walk (half (i) applies, no type question) inside the window cntAt_le_nxtAt_succ_of_idle_past / pend_past_of_nxtAt_lt impose, or a forced lengthening of the NEXT pending region (in which case Q1 and Q2 recur there)?

Q5 (refutability before a third plan). Two constructions for this obligation were refuted after being planned (Probe761S, Probe761C). Before a third plan, assess whether CellLEZeroConstOfKappaEq itself has a candidate separating object -- e.g. an object and labelling where every type-respecting block in every long pending region has a length that shares a factor with, but does not divide, the required shift, or where the n-pins obstruct -- and whether the all-histories quantification of the cell absorbs it. Report either a sketched non-refutation argument or a concrete candidate counter-object to probe FIRST; a compiled probe either way is the strongest input the plan can receive.

Q6 (placement and consumed interface). Can the construction live in LadderAgree.lean under its certificate-freedom contract (imports AnchorLayer and CounterQuotient only; no cohIdle, SatCl, prodPre_periodic, satThreshold or satPeriod) and its longFile cap of 2400 (2241 lines now), or does it need a new module such as RaySummary/LadderPump.lean importing LadderAgree? List the landed lemmas it consumes (spliceIdx/spliceEmb, exists_ladderPath_of_walk and its pin side condition, mem_cellAt_ladder_iff, tpOf_stabFree_eq_of_lab_eq, kappa_eq_components, eq_or_both_ge_of_min_eq, clipIdx_regime_of_eq) so the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block and per-phase file lists can be pinned rather than guessed.
